mass_basis: neutral deacylated glycerol plus head, fatty-chain sockets capped with H
final_user_mass_policy: 2026-10-26: ordinary cores 500 Da with or without P; sugar and previously approved inositol 600 Da; frozen
identity: one stereo-free graph with explicit glycerol chain-site roles; one target ID only
scope: all recorded lipid head families including nonphosphorus glycerolipids, not only six classical GP classes
aminoacylation: source alpha-carboxyl only, one residue on a free head alcohol, never phosphate OH
halogens: hold for separate natural evidence; no halogen introduction
reactive_acyl_phosphate: retain source and audit, do not include in default target proposal
